content.title: The Winner of 'The Voice' Season 29 (2026) Is Revealed
content.text: Key PointsThe Voice Season 29 winner is Alexia Jayy, announced after finale performances and voting.Coaches performed duets with their finalists; each contestant sang both uptempo and ballad songs.Runners-up were Liv Ciara (2nd), Lucas West (3rd), and Mikenley Brown (4th). After a season of Blind Auditions, Battles, Knockouts, and Semifinals, The Voice: Battle of Champions finale performances by the Top 4 — Alexia Jayy, Liv Ciara, Lucas West, or Mikenley Brown — took place tonight, with each artist doing an up-tempo song and a ballad. Then the results of the vote by an audience of superfans and past Voice contestants was revealed with The Voice’s Season 29 winner announced at the end of the night. Also, coaches Kelly Clarkson, Adam Levine and John Legend performed duets with their final artists. 🎤 SIGN UP for our The Voice newsletter to get access to exclusive news, interviews, insider info, sneak peeks & more🎤 Who Was Eliminated on The Voice tonight? Liv CiaraLucas WestMikenley Brown Alexia Jayy Here’s how the night broke down: ALEXIA JAYY Song: “Lady Marmalade” by Labelle Adam said: “She’s tackled Whitney, Aretha, Patti LaBelle, all these mega people. The headline through all of it was you were what made those moments so special. Alexia killed with ‘Lady Marmalade.’” MIKENLEY BROWN Song: “Almost is Never Enough” by Ariana Grande Kelly said: “Your voice is so good and gorgeous. You do these riffs that are incredible. That I try to do in my shower and can’t. You are so special.” LUCAS WEST Song: “Cold As Ice” by Foreigner John said: “I loved it, Lucas. Your voice sounded more powerful and clear. I love you doing something different than you have ever done before.” LIV CIARA Song: “The Greatest” by Billie Eilish Kelly said: “Oh, my God. You’re so good. When we were 16, I don’t know that we were you. You have such a vision for yourself. I’m looking forward to seeing what you do after this show. Liv is able to tap into something at such a young age.” MIKENLEY BROWN Song: “Man I Need” by Olivia Dean Kelly said: “It is just so rad. If people turned in tonight, they have a great idea of who you are. Your chest to head voice stuff, keep doing that. Mikenley killed it. Her tone is so special. She’s so unique.” LUCAS WEST Song: “Ordinary People” by John Legend John said: “I was just so happy watching you do this today. You told me your mother used to play these songs. As artists, it’s cool. We want to make things that inspire people. I felt something today. I am so proud of Lucas. I love working with a real musician, who knows what it means to be a pianist and an arranger.” LIV CIARA Song: “What a Girl Wants” by Christina Aguilera Kelly said: “You are ready to be a pop star. You sing, you write, you arrange. I am super proud of Liv. She is a soulful pop star. She’s ready to go.” ALEXIA JAYY Song: “One and Only” by Adele Adam said: “Wow! You are important. You make people reflect on their own life when you tap into that you make the world feel more together and communal. That is really special. I never experienced the feeling that we all just had together. Thans for being the messenger.” Before the results were announced, the coaches dueted with their artists. Kelly and Liv performed “Stay,” Adam and Alexia sang “Sunday Morning,” John and Lucas hit the keyboards for “Don’t Let the Sun Go Down on Me,” and then Kelly and Mikenley wrapped up the performances with “What Was I Made For?” Then it was time for host Carson Daly to reveal the results of the vote: The finalist in fourth place was Mikenley Brown. The finalist in third place was Lucas West. The finalist in second place was Liv Ciara. And the winner of The Voice Season 29 was Alexia Jayy. Next, Is The Voice Returning for Season 30?
